source.text: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹתבְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: The song of the ascents. When YHWH restored the restoration of Zion, we were like [those who] dream.

en.L: A song of ascents. \q When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} brought about the restoration of Zion, \q we were like those dreaming.
en.B: A song of ascents. \q When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} turned things around for Zion, \q we were like people in a dream.
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. \q When {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} restored Zion and made everything good again, \q it was like a dream to us.

fr.L: Cantique des montées. \q Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rétabli le sort de Sion, \q nous étions comme ceux qui rêvent.
fr.B: Cantique des montées. \q Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rétabli le sort de Sion, \q nous étions comme des gens qui rêvent.
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. \q Quand {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a relevé Sion et que tout est redevenu bon, \q c’était pour nous comme un rêve.

sw.L: Wimbo wa kupanda. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipoleta marejesho ya Sayuni, tulikuwa kama wanaota ndoto.
sw.B: Wimbo wa kupanda. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipoigeuza hali ya Sayuni, tulikuwa kama watu walio ndotoni.
sw.R: Wimbo wa safari ya kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipoirejesha Sayuni na kufanya kila kitu kuwa kizuri tena, ilikuwa kama ndoto kwetu.

es.L: Cántico de las subidas. \q Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo volver la restauración de Sion, \q estábamos como los que sueñan.
es.B: Cántico de las subidas. \q Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cambió la suerte de Sion, \q éramos como gente que sueña.
es.R: Canto para el viaje de subida a Jerusalén. \q Cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} restauró a Sion y volvió a hacer todo bueno, \q nos pareció un sueño.

vi.L: Bài ca cho những lần đi lên. Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem lại sự phục hồi cho Si-ôn, chúng tôi như những người đang mơ.
vi.B: Bài ca đi lên. Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xoay chuyển mọi sự cho Si-ôn, chúng tôi như người đang nằm mơ.
vi.R: Bài ca cho cuộc hành trình lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. Khi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phục hồi Si-ôn và làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại, chúng tôi tưởng như mình đang mơ.

ko.L: 올라감을 위한 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온의 회복을 이루셨을 때, 우리는 꿈꾸는 자들 같았다.
ko.B: 올라가며 부르는 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온의 형편을 되돌려 주셨을 때, 우리는 꿈을 꾸는 사람들 같았다.
ko.R: 예루살렘으로 올라가며 부르는 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온을 회복시키시고 모든 것을 다시 좋게 해 주셨을 때, 우리는 꿈을 꾸는 것만 같았다.

pt.L: Cântico dos degraus. \q Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} realizou a restauração de Sião, \q estávamos como os que sonham.
pt.B: Cântico das subidas. \q Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} transformou a situação de Sião, \q era como se vivêssemos um sonho.
pt.R: Canção para a subida a Jerusalém. \q Quando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} restaurou Sião e fez tudo ficar bem de novo, \q aquilo pareceu um sonho para nós.

am.L: የመውጣት መዝሙር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የጽዮንን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፣ እንደሚያልሙ [ሰዎች] ሆንን።
am.B: የመውጣት መዝሙር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የጽዮንን ዕድል በመለሰ ጊዜ፣ በሕልም እንዳሉ ሰዎች ሆንን።
am.R: የመውጣት መዝሙር፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጡ የሚዘመር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጽዮንን ወደ ቀድሞዋ በመለሰና ሁሉንም ነገር እንደ ገና መልካም ባደረገ ጊዜ፣ ለእኛ እንደ ሕልም ሆነልን።

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: restored the restoration: made things as they were
alternatives: brought back the captives of Zion
decisions.reason: The phrase (shuv shivat) means to turn things back to how they were, to restore a people's fortunes (14:7; 85:2; Job 42:10). Because it sounds like the word for captivity, it has also been read "brought back the captives". The return from exile in Babylon (Ezra 1) is the likeliest occasion, though the psalm does not name it.

decisions.choice: like those who dream: too good to be true
decisions.reason: The rescue seemed too wonderful to be real. The same verb can mean "be made strong" (Isaiah 38:16), and the ancient Greek translation has "like those comforted".

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 120:1.

decisions.choice: it was like a dream to us
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the comparison means (m4).

decisions.choice: "a rétabli le sort de Sion" (L, B) for "restored the restoration"
decisions.reason: French cannot repeat the root as the Hebrew does without an awkward phrase. The meaning decision reads the phrase as making things as they were; Literal and Balanced use "rétablir le sort", the wording the prophets' terms notes set for this phrase (also 126:4 L).

decisions.choice: "restored the restoration of Zion" as "የጽዮንን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ" (Literal), "የጽዮንን ዕድል በመለሰ ጊዜ" (Balanced), "ወደ ቀድሞዋ በመለሰ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The phrase means making things as they were (meaning decision m3), whether or not a return from captivity is meant; Literal keeps the familiar "captivity" picture of the phrase, Balanced and Readable say "turned her fortunes", as the English does. Verse 4 follows the same pattern.

source.text: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֪נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Then was filled [with] laughter our mouth and our tongue [with] a shout of joy; then they said among the nations, YHWH has made great to do with these.

en.L: Then our mouth was filled [with] laughter and our tongue [with] shouts of joy; \q then they said among the nations, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has done great things with these."
en.B: Then we laughed and laughed, and our tongues rang with joyful shouts. \q Then people among the nations said, \q "What great things {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done for them!"
en.R: We laughed and laughed. We shouted for joy. \q People in other nations said, \q "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has done wonderful things for them!"

fr.L: Alors notre bouche s’est remplie de rire, et notre langue de cris de joie ; \q alors on a dit parmi les nations : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait de grandes choses avec ceux-ci. »
fr.B: Alors nous avons ri, ri encore, et nos langues ont éclaté en cris de joie. \q Alors parmi les nations on a dit : \q « Quelles grandes choses {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a faites pour eux ! »
fr.R: Nous avons ri et ri encore. Nous avons crié de joie. \q Les gens des autres nations ont dit : \q « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait des choses merveilleuses pour eux ! »

sw.L: Ndipo kinywa chetu kilijazwa kicheko na ulimi wetu kelele za furaha; ndipo walisema kati ya mataifa, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefanya makuu pamoja na hawa."
sw.B: Ndipo tukacheka na kucheka, na ndimi zetu zikavuma kwa kelele za furaha. Ndipo watu kati ya mataifa wakasema, "Ni mambo makuu namna gani {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewatendea!"
sw.R: Tulicheka na kucheka. Tulipiga kelele kwa furaha. Watu wa mataifa mengine walisema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewatendea mambo ya ajabu!"

es.L: Entonces nuestra boca se llenó [de] risa y nuestra lengua [de] gritos de alegría; \q entonces decían entre las naciones: \q «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho grandes cosas con estos».
es.B: Entonces nos reíamos y nos reíamos, y nuestras lenguas resonaban con gritos de alegría. \q Entonces la gente de las naciones decía: \q «¡Qué grandes cosas ha hecho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} por ellos!».
es.R: Nos reíamos y reíamos. Gritábamos de alegría. \q La gente de otras naciones decía: \q «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho cosas maravillosas por ellos!».

vi.L: Bấy giờ miệng chúng tôi đầy [tiếng] cười và lưỡi chúng tôi [đầy] tiếng reo vui; bấy giờ người ta nói giữa các dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm những việc lớn cho những người này."
vi.B: Bấy giờ chúng tôi cười mãi không thôi, và lưỡi chúng tôi vang lên tiếng reo hò vui mừng. Bấy giờ người ta nói giữa các dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho họ những việc lớn biết bao!"
vi.R: Chúng tôi cười mãi không thôi. Chúng tôi reo hò vui mừng. Người ở các dân tộc khác nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho họ những việc thật tuyệt vời!"

ko.L: 그때에 우리 입은 웃음으로, 우리 혀는 기쁨의 환호로 가득 찼다. 그때에 민족들 가운데서 사람들이 말하였다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이들에게 큰일을 행하셨다."
ko.B: 그때에 우리는 웃고 또 웃었고, 우리 혀에서는 기쁨의 환호가 울려 퍼졌다. 그때에 민족들 가운데서 사람들이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 위해 참으로 큰일을 하셨구나!"
ko.R: 우리는 웃고 또 웃었다. 우리는 기뻐서 소리쳤다. 다른 민족 사람들도 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저들에게 놀라운 일을 해 주셨다!"

pt.L: Então a nossa boca se encheu [de] riso e a nossa língua [de] gritos de alegria; \q então diziam entre as nações: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez grandes coisas com estes."
pt.B: Então rimos sem parar, e a nossa língua ressoava com gritos de alegria. \q Então as pessoas entre as nações diziam: \q "Que grandes coisas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez por eles!"
pt.R: Nós rimos e rimos. Gritamos de alegria. \q As pessoas de outras nações diziam: \q "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez coisas maravilhosas por eles!"

am.L: ያን ጊዜ አፋችን ሳቅን፣ አንደበታችንም እልልታን ተሞላ፤ ያን ጊዜ በሕዝቦች መካከል፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእነዚህ ጋር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገ» አሉ።
am.B: ያን ጊዜ ሳቅን፣ ሳቅን፤ አንደበታችንም በእልልታ ተሞላ። ያን ጊዜ በሕዝቦች መካከል ያሉ ሰዎች፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእነርሱ እንዴት ያለ ታላቅ ነገር አደረገላቸው!» አሉ።
am.R: ሳቅን፤ ሳቅን። በደስታ እልል አልን። በሌሎች ሕዝቦች መካከል ያሉ ሰዎች፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእነርሱ ድንቅ ነገር አደረገላቸው!» አሉ።

decisions.choice: a shout of joy: a ringing cry of joy
decisions.reason: The word (rinnah) is a loud cry, usually of joy or praise. It comes three times in this psalm (verses 2, 5, 6).

decisions.choice: made great to do: done great things
decisions.reason: The verb "make great" with "to do" means to do something great (Joel 2:20-21; 1 Samuel 12:24). Verse 3 repeats the nations' words as Israel's own.

decisions.choice: the nations: witnesses of what God did
decisions.reason: Even outsiders see that Israel's restoration is the LORD's work, as God's acts for Israel were to be seen by the nations (98:2-3; Ezekiel 36:36).

decisions.choice: "민족들" for the nations
decisions.reason: As the terms note; "열방" and "이방" are older church words. Readable says "other peoples" (다른 민족), as the English Readable does.

source.text: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH has made great to do with us; we were glad.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has done great things with us; \q we were glad.
en.B: Great things indeed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has done for us, \q and how glad we were!
en.R: Yes, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did wonderful things for us, \q and we were so happy!

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait de grandes choses avec nous ; \q nous étions dans la joie.
fr.B: Oui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait pour nous de grandes choses, \q et quelle a été notre joie !
fr.R: Oui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait des choses merveilleuses pour nous, \q et nous étions si heureux !

sw.B: Hakika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametutendea mambo makuu, na jinsi tulivyofurahi!
sw.R: Ndiyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alitutendea mambo ya ajabu, nasi tukafurahi sana!

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho grandes cosas con nosotros; \q estábamos alegres.
es.B: Grandes cosas, en verdad, ha hecho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} por nosotros, \q ¡y qué alegres estábamos!
es.R: Sí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo cosas maravillosas por nosotros, \q ¡y estábamos tan felices!

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm những việc lớn cho chúng tôi; chúng tôi đã vui mừng.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho chúng tôi những việc lớn, và chúng tôi vui mừng biết bao!
vi.R: Đúng vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho chúng tôi những việc tuyệt vời, và chúng tôi rất vui!

ko.B: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 위해 큰일을 하셨으니, 우리가 얼마나 기뻤던가!
ko.R: 그렇다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리를 위해 놀라운 일을 해 주셨다. 그래서 우리는 정말 기뻤다!

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez grandes coisas conosco; \q ficamos alegres.
pt.B: Grandes coisas, de fato, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez por nós, \q e que alegria sentimos!
pt.R: Sim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez coisas maravilhosas por nós, \q e ficamos muito felizes!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከእኛ ጋር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገ፤ ደስ አለን።
am.B: በእርግጥም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገልን፤ እንዴትስ ደስ አለን!
am.R: አዎን፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ድንቅ ነገር አደረገልን፤ እኛም በጣም ደስ አለን!

decisions.choice: the nations' words taken up
decisions.reason: Israel repeats what the nations said in verse 2, changing "for these" to "for us".

decisions.choice: we were glad: we became glad
decisions.reason: The verb "to be" in this form usually describes what happened: the people were filled with joy. Some take it as their present state.

records.literal_gloss: Restore, YHWH, our fortunes like stream-beds in the Negev.

en.L: Bring back our fortunes, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q like stream-beds in the Negev.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, restore us again, \q as the rains bring the dry streams of the Negev back to life.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, make things good for us again, \q like the rains that fill the dry streams in the southern desert.

fr.L: Rétablis notre sort, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q comme les torrents dans le Néguev.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, relève-nous encore, \q comme les pluies rendent la vie aux torrents à sec du Néguev.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, rends-nous de nouveau heureux, \q comme les pluies qui remplissent les ruisseaux secs du désert du Sud.

sw.L: Urudishe hali yetu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama vijito katika Negebu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, uturejeshe tena, kama mvua inavyovirudishia uhai vijito vikavu vya Negebu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ufanye mambo yawe mazuri kwetu tena, kama mvua inavyojaza vijito vikavu katika jangwa la kusini.

es.L: Restaura nuestra suerte, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q como los arroyos en el Négueb.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, restáuranos otra vez, \q como las lluvias devuelven la vida a los arroyos secos del Négueb.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, vuelve a hacer que todo nos vaya bien, \q como las lluvias que llenan los arroyos secos del desierto del sur.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin phục hồi vận mệnh chúng tôi, như những lòng suối ở Nê-ghép.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin phục hồi chúng tôi một lần nữa, như mưa làm cho những dòng suối khô ở Nê-ghép chảy tràn trở lại.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp lại cho chúng tôi, như mưa đổ đầy những dòng suối khô ở miền sa mạc phía nam.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희의 형편을 되돌려 주십시오, 네겝의 시내들처럼.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 비가 메마른 네겝의 시냇물을 되살리듯, 저희를 다시 회복시켜 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 비가 남쪽 사막의 마른 시내를 채우듯이, 저희에게 다시 좋은 날을 주십시오.

pt.L: Traz de volta a nossa sorte, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q como os leitos de torrentes no Neguebe.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, restaura-nos outra vez, \q como as chuvas trazem de volta à vida os riachos secos do Neguebe.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, faz tudo ficar bem para nós de novo, \q como as chuvas que enchem os riachos secos no deserto do sul.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ምርኮአችንን በኔጌብ እንዳሉ ፈፋዎች መልስ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ዝናብ የኔጌብን ደረቅ ፈፋዎች ሕያው እንደሚያደርግ፣ እኛንም እንደ ገና መልሰን።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ዝናብ በደቡቡ ምድረ በዳ ያሉትን ደረቅ ፈፋዎች እንደሚሞላ፣ ለእኛም ነገሮችን እንደ ገና መልካም አድርግልን።

decisions.choice: the form to be read
decisions.reason: Here the words follow the form to be read; the written form, which the data used here does not print, differs slightly. The sense "our fortunes" is the same as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: a prayer after a restoration
decisions.reason: Verses 1-3 remember a restoration; verse 4 prays for the LORD to do it again or to complete it. The people are back, but their life is not yet fully restored.

decisions.choice: streams in the Negev: dry beds filled by rain
decisions.reason: The Negev is the dry land in the south of Judah. Its stream beds are dry for most of the year, but the winter rains suddenly fill them and the desert turns green. The prayer asks for a restoration that is just as sudden and full.

decisions.choice: as the rains bring ... back to life (B); like the rains that fill (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture means (m3); Readable also explains "the Negev".

decisions.choice: "vận mệnh chúng tôi" (our fortunes) at Literal, as in verse 1
alternatives: "những kẻ bị lưu đày của chúng tôi" (our captives)
decisions.reason: The words follow the form to be read, with the sense "our fortunes" as in verse 1 (see the meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "restore us", as the English does.

decisions.choice: The singers turn to pray to God in 합쇼체, calling themselves "저희"
decisions.reason: Verses 1-3 tell of the LORD in the plain written style; verse 4 speaks to him, so Korean changes to the humble plural and the polite style of prayer (style guide section 7a).

decisions.choice: the Negev as "ኔጌብ" (Literal, Balanced), "በደቡቡ ምድረ በዳ" (Readable)
decisions.reason: "ኔጌብ" is the form of 1 Samuel 27:10 and 30:1 on main; Readable says where it is, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: Those who sow with tears with a shout of joy will reap.

en.L: Those who sow with tears \q will reap with shouts of joy.
en.B: People who sow their seed in tears \q will bring in the harvest with songs of joy.
en.R: People who cry as they plant their seed will shout for joy when they gather the harvest.

fr.L: Ceux qui sèment avec larmes \q moissonneront avec des cris de joie.
fr.B: Ceux qui sèment leur grain dans les larmes \q rentreront la moisson avec des chants de joie.
fr.R: Les gens qui pleurent en semant leur grain crieront de joie quand ils récolteront la moisson.

sw.L: Wale wanaopanda kwa machozi, kwa shangwe watavuna.
sw.B: Watu wanaopanda mbegu zao huku wakilia watavuna mavuno kwa nyimbo za furaha.
sw.R: Watu wanaolia wanapopanda mbegu zao watapiga kelele za furaha wanapovuna mavuno.

es.L: Los que siembran con lágrimas \q con gritos de alegría cosecharán.
es.B: Los que siembran su semilla entre lágrimas \q recogerán la cosecha con cantos de alegría.
es.R: La gente que llora mientras siembra su semilla gritará de alegría cuando recoja la cosecha.

vi.L: Những người gieo trong nước mắt sẽ gặt với tiếng reo vui.
vi.B: Những ai gieo giống trong nước mắt sẽ gặt hái với những bài ca vui mừng.
vi.R: Những người vừa gieo hạt vừa khóc sẽ reo hò vui mừng khi gặt hái mùa màng.

ko.L: 눈물 속에 씨 뿌리는 자들은 기쁨의 환호 속에 거둘 것이다.
ko.B: 씨앗을 뿌리며 눈물짓던 사람들이 기쁨의 노래 속에 곡식을 거두어들일 것이다.
ko.R: 울면서 씨를 심는 사람들이 추수할 때에는 기뻐 소리칠 것이다.

pt.L: Os que semeiam com lágrimas \q colherão com gritos de alegria.
pt.B: Quem semeia chorando \q vai fazer a colheita com cânticos de alegria.
pt.R: As pessoas que choram enquanto plantam as suas sementes vão gritar de alegria quando fizerem a colheita.

am.B: ዘራቸውን በእንባ የሚዘሩ በደስታ ዝማሬ ያጭዳሉ።
am.R: ዘር ሲዘሩ የሚያለቅሱ ሰዎች፣ መከሩን በሚሰበስቡበት ጊዜ በደስታ እልል ይላሉ።

decisions.choice: sowing in tears, reaping with joy
decisions.reason: Sowing in a hard year meant giving up grain that could have been eaten, with no certainty of a harvest. The picture is of a hard and hopeful beginning that the LORD will turn to joy (Isaiah 61:3; Jeremiah 31:9-14).

decisions.choice: will reap: a promise
decisions.reason: The verb looks forward: what was sown in tears will be harvested with joy. It may also be heard as a wish that goes with the prayer of verse 4.

source.text: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ׀וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ־הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽ֬א־יָב֥וֹאבְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Going he goes and weeping, carrying the bag of the seed; coming he will come with a shout of joy, carrying his sheaves.

en.L: Going, {{gender:the sower goes|he goes}} out weeping, carrying the bag of seed; \q coming, {{gender:the sower|he}} will come [home] with shouts of joy, \q carrying {{gender:the|his}} sheaves.
en.B: People may go out in tears as they carry the seed for sowing, \q but they will surely come home shouting for joy, \q their arms full of sheaves.
en.R: Farmers may cry as they go out to plant their seed. \q But they will come back home shouting for joy, \q carrying bundles of grain from the harvest.

fr.L: Il va, il va en pleurant, portant le sac de la semence ; \q il reviendra, il reviendra avec des cris de joie, \q portant ses gerbes.
fr.B: On peut partir en larmes en portant la semence, \q mais on reviendra sûrement avec des cris de joie, \q les bras chargés de gerbes.
fr.R: Les paysans pleurent parfois en partant semer leur grain. \q Mais ils reviendront à la maison en criant de joie, \q avec des bottes de blé de la moisson.

sw.L: Kwenda, anakwenda akilia, akibeba mfuko wa mbegu; kuja, atakuja [nyumbani] kwa shangwe, akibeba miganda yake.
sw.B: Watu wanaweza kutoka wakitoa machozi wanapobeba mbegu za kupanda, lakini hakika watarudi nyumbani wakipiga kelele za furaha, mikono yao imejaa miganda.
sw.R: Wakulima wanaweza kulia wanapotoka kwenda kupanda mbegu zao. Lakini watarudi nyumbani wakipiga kelele za furaha, wakibeba mafungu ya nafaka ya mavuno.

es.L: Va y va llorando el que lleva la bolsa de la semilla; \q vendrá, vendrá [a casa] con gritos de alegría, \q cargando sus gavillas.
es.B: Puede que salgan llorando mientras llevan la semilla para sembrar, \q pero sin duda volverán a casa gritando de alegría, \q con los brazos llenos de gavillas.
es.R: Puede que los campesinos lloren al salir a sembrar su semilla. \q Pero volverán a casa gritando de alegría, \q cargando los manojos de grano de la cosecha.

vi.L: Người gieo giống đi ra, vừa đi vừa khóc, mang theo túi hạt giống; người ấy chắc chắn sẽ trở về với tiếng reo vui, mang theo những bó lúa của mình.
vi.B: Người ta có thể vừa đi vừa khóc khi mang hạt giống ra gieo, nhưng chắc chắn họ sẽ trở về reo hò vui mừng, tay ôm đầy những bó lúa.
vi.R: Người nông dân có thể khóc khi ra đồng gieo hạt. Nhưng họ sẽ trở về nhà reo hò vui mừng, mang theo những bó lúa đã gặt.

ko.L: 나가고 또 나가며 우는 이가 씨 자루를 메고 [가지만], 돌아오고 또 돌아올 때는 기쁨의 환호 속에 자기 곡식 단을 지고 올 것이다.
ko.B: 사람들이 씨앗을 메고 눈물 속에 나갈지라도, 두 팔 가득 곡식 단을 안고 기뻐 소리치며 반드시 돌아올 것이다.
ko.R: 농부들이 씨앗을 심으러 나가면서 울지도 모른다. 그러나 그들은 추수한 곡식 단을 안고 기뻐 소리치며 집으로 돌아올 것이다.

pt.L: Indo, vai chorando, levando o saco da semente; \q vindo, voltará com gritos de alegria, \q trazendo os seus feixes.
pt.B: As pessoas podem sair chorando enquanto levam a semente para semear, \q mas certamente voltarão para casa gritando de alegria, \q com os braços cheios de feixes.
pt.R: Os agricultores podem chorar quando saem para plantar as suas sementes. \q Mas eles vão voltar para casa gritando de alegria, \q carregando feixes de cereal da colheita.

am.L: ዘር የሚዘራበትን ከረጢት ተሸክሞ እያለቀሰ መሄድን ይሄዳል፤ ነዶውን ተሸክሞ በእልልታ መምጣትን ይመጣል።
am.B: ሰዎች ለመዝራት የሚሆነውን ዘር ተሸክመው በእንባ ይሄዱ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን እቅፋቸውን በነዶ ሞልተው በእልልታ ወደ ቤታቸው በእርግጥ ይመለሳሉ።
am.R: ገበሬዎች ዘራቸውን ለመዝራት ሲወጡ ያለቅሱ ይሆናል። ነገር ግን የእህላቸውን ነዶ ተሸክመው በደስታ እልል እያሉ ወደ ቤታቸው ይመለሳሉ።

decisions.choice: going he goes ... coming he will come
decisions.reason: Each verb is doubled (an infinitive with the finite verb), which stresses it: the sower keeps going out weeping, and will surely come back with joy.

decisions.choice: the bag of seed: the seed carried for sowing
decisions.reason: The word (meshek) comes from a verb meaning to draw or drag; here it is the seed the sower carries and scatters, perhaps the bag or the handful drawn from it.

decisions.choice: sheaves: bundles of cut grain
decisions.reason: At harvest the cut stalks of grain were tied into sheaves and carried home (129:7; Genesis 37:7).

decisions.choice: people, they; farmers, they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew draws one sower ("he") who stands for anyone who sows in tears. Balanced and Readable make the picture plural; Literal keeps the singular with the gender setting.

decisions.choice: no gender setting: "il va" (Literal), "on" (Balanced), "les paysans" (Readable)
alternatives: a gender setting on the pronoun, as the English Literal has it
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a setting on "he". French settled in this book to put gender settings on nouns only: "il" for the sower who stands for anyone is ordinary generic French, and Balanced and Readable are already inclusive.

decisions.choice: The sower as the verb prefix "a-" (anakwenda, atakuja) with no gender setting
alternatives: "mpanzi" (the sower) written out, as the English inclusive option does
decisions.reason: Swahili "a-" means he or she alike, so the sentence already speaks of any sower and the English setting has nothing to change in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "Va y va llorando el que lleva...", with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a setting for "he" or "the sower". Spanish leaves the subject in the verb and names him as "el que lleva la bolsa", which speaks of whoever sows, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: "người gieo giống", "người ấy" (L) with no gender span
alternatives: gender spans as in the English ("the sower"/"he")
decisions.reason: "người" and "người ấy" already mean a man or a woman, so Vietnamese has no second form for the setting to switch to, as in Psalm 1.

decisions.choice: "이" (the one) and "사람들" with no gender span; Literal repeats the verbs ("나가고 또 나가며", "돌아오고 또 돌아올")
decisions.reason: Korean needs no pronoun for the sower and its words for a person include women and men, so there is no second wording for the English span. The doubled verbs echo the Hebrew's repeated "going ... coming" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: verbs without a subject, "os seus feixes", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "the sower|he" under the gender setting. Portuguese can leave the subject out, as the Hebrew verbs do, and "os seus feixes" is the same for a man or a woman, so the singular sower of the Hebrew is kept with nothing for the setting to change. Balanced and Readable make the picture plural, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "going he goes … coming he will come" as "መሄድን ይሄዳል … መምጣትን ይመጣል", keeping the Hebrew doubling
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew infinitive with its verb (meaning decision m1); the doubled verb is heard as emphatic in Amharic too.

decisions.choice: no gender span for "he" (the sower): Literal uses the plain third person, Balanced and Readable "ሰዎች", "ገበሬዎች"
alternatives: a span like the English "the sower" / "he"
decisions.reason: An Amharic verb in the third person singular speaks of anyone who sows, with no word to change; Balanced and Readable say "people", "farmers", as the English does.
